fluff.overview: Reforms begun under Alessandro Steiner and reinforced by Federated Suns influence have integrated Lyran infantry into combined-arms operations more effectively than at any point in the Commonwealth's history. Mechanized tracked platoons deploy from armored personnel carriers that provide protection during movement and allow the formation to keep pace with heavier combat vehicles in offensive operations. Armed with standard assault rifles and supplemented by man-portable flamers, these platoons can both engage enemy personnel at range and deny terrain or flush defenders from cover with incendiary fire.
